users:read.description: See the user directory: accounts, type, status, permission sets, last sign-in and project counts.

users:edit.description: Edit a member's name and email.

users:disable.description: Disable or enable a member: blocks sign-in and revokes their sessions and MCP tokens.

users:delete.description: Delete a member, transferring what they own.

users:reset_credentials.description: Send a member a reset link or set a temporary password. As strong as taking the account over.

users:revoke_sessions.description: Sign a member out everywhere and revoke their MCP tokens.

users:assign_permissions.description: Assign permission sets and overrides to members (only permissions you hold), and review legacy access.

users:impersonate.description: Act as a member. As strong as taking the account over.

admins:manage.description: Create, promote, demote, disable and delete administrators, and assign admin profiles.

roles:manage.description: Create and edit member permission sets.

projects:oversee.description: Read any project without acting as its owner, at the Read level; audited and visible to the owner.

projects:administer.description: Transfer any project, force-remove its shares or delete it (break-glass).

instance:settings.description: Change the security policy, the sharing policy and the defaults for new users.

instance:quotas.description: Set quotas per permission set or per user.

platform:plugins.description: Install, update, enable, disable, roll back and uninstall plugins; read their logs; grant plugin permissions.

platform:traffic_capture.description: Configure the instance-wide traffic capture: the capture proxy, egress policy, retention and SCA ignore list.

platform:tunnels.description: Configure and enable the ngrok or chisel tunnel every user shares.

platform:nuclei_templates.description: Manage every custom Nuclei template: the instance's and other people's.

platform:agent_mcp.description: Reload the agent's MCP servers and manage the system MCP servers.

platform:emergency_stop.description: Stop every user's running agent runs at once.

platform:shell_sessions.description: See, use and kill every Metasploit and shell session on the instance.

platform:kali_terminal.description: Open the raw Kali terminal: a shared sandbox where every project's files are visible.

platform:operations.description: See every user's running and queued scans, agent runs and triage runs, and the system load.

self:llm_providers.description: Add your own LLM providers and keys.

self:api_keys.description: Store your own third-party API keys and their rotation.

self:mcp_servers.description: Register outbound MCP servers for your own agent runs.

self:mcp_tokens.description: Mint MCP tokens for yourself; their scopes are limited by your permissions.

self:attack_skills.description: Upload, generate and import your own agent attack skills.

self:presets.description: Keep your own recon presets and mute-rule presets.

project:share.description: Share your projects and manage their members.

project:settings.description: Edit the recon pipeline and agent settings of a project.

project:rescope.description: Change a project's targets and scope.

roe:read.description: Read the rules of engagement document.

roe:manage.description: Upload, replace, remove and parse the rules of engagement document.

auth_profile:manage.description: Set the project's authenticated-session credentials and record sessions.

project:export.description: Export the whole project with all its data.

project:delete.description: Delete the project and everything in it.

project:transfer.description: Give ownership of the project to one of its members.

recon:read.description: Read recon status, logs, outputs, deltas and graph inputs, and download results.

recon:scan.description: Start, pause, resume and stop a full recon.

recon:partial.description: Run a single recon phase (partial recon).

recon:overwrite.description: Run recon in overwrite mode, discarding the current graph.

recon:schedule.description: Queue scans, schedule them, and cancel or reconfirm queued jobs.

scan:secrets.description: Run the GitHub secret hunt and TruffleHog, and manage their sources and profiles.

scan:supply_chain.description: Run supply-chain scans, uploads and organisation batches.

scan:ai_attack.description: Run AI attack-surface scans (spends LLM credits).

scan:uploads.description: Upload wordlists and JS recon custom files.

scan:custom_templates.description: Upload your own custom Nuclei templates and select your own and instance templates for the project.

scan:versions.description: Save, activate, pin and rename scan versions.

scan:versions_delete.description: Delete scan versions and clear the scan history.

preset:apply.description: Apply a recon preset to the project.

agent:chat.description: Talk to the agent in the informational and recon phases, in your own conversations.

agent:approve_phase.description: Approve the move into exploitation and post-exploitation.

agent:approve_dangerous.description: Answer the confirmations of dangerous agent tools.

agent:loop.description: Use Agent in the Loop: pick the loop model and drive it over MCP.

agent:kali_exec.description: Run commands in the Kali sandbox over MCP. The sandbox is shared with every other project on this server.

agent:assistants.description: Use the text-to-Cypher and command assistants (spends LLM credits).

agent:conversations_share.description: Share your conversations with the members of the project.

workspace:read.description: Browse, preview, download and archive the agent's workspace.

workspace:write.description: Upload, create folders, rename, delete and reset in the workspace; cancel background jobs.

workspace:import.description: Import into the workspace from a URL or GitHub.

graph:read.description: See the graph, the Insights dashboards and attack chains.

graph:cypher.description: Run raw Cypher queries and custom-Cypher graph views.

graph:views.description: Create, edit and delete saved graph views.

graph:edit.description: Delete graph nodes, purge orphan chains and wipe the graph.

triage:read.description: Read the Priority Board, findings, evidence and the muted list.

triage:verdict.description: Record a person's verdict on a finding.

triage:review.description: Submit an agent's review of a finding's score.

triage:run.description: Start or stop an AI triage run (spends LLM credits).

node_filters:manage.description: Edit, preview, apply, arm and disarm mute rules, and clear exemptions.

codefix:run.description: Generate fixes and pull requests with CypherFix CodeFix.

traffic:read.description: Browse captured traffic: bodies, headers, cookies and credentials.

traffic:replay.description: Replay and fuzz requests through the capture proxy.

auth_profile:read.description: See that an authenticated-session profile exists and its details, never its secrets.

plugins:use.description: See plugin screens and run plugin actions.

plugins:approve_overrides.description: Approve, reject and reset skill text a plugin proposes, for yourself or a project.

sets.name: Default member
sets.description: What every member can do today: their own projects, scans, the agent with exploitation, and their own keys and tokens. Members with no set hold it.

sets.name: Read-only analyst
sets.description: Consumes results: the graph, Insights, the Priority Board and reports, and the Cypher and command assistants. No scans, no agent chat, no keys.

sets.name: Recon operator
sets.description: Everything up to scanning, and the agent without exploitation: no approvals into exploitation, no shell sessions, no Kali commands.

sets.name: Red-team operator
sets.description: Full offensive use: the agent with exploitation and post-exploitation, shell sessions, Fireteam and Kali commands.

sets.name: Automation
sets.description: For accounts that drive RedAmon over MCP: MCP tokens, project creation, reads, writes and scans, and Agent in the Loop. No other agent use, no exploitation.

sets.name: No access
sets.description: Nothing at all: the way to leave an account without rights short of disabling it.

sets.name: Full admin
sets.description: Every administration and platform permission except Root's own.

sets.name: User manager
sets.description: Runs the user directory: create and invite, edit, disable, reset credentials, sign out and assign member permission sets. No platform tools, no acting as a member.

sets.name: Platform operator
sets.description: Runs the instance: plugins, traffic capture, tunnels, Nuclei templates, the agent's MCP servers, emergency stop, every shell session and the operations view. No user management.

sets.name: Security auditor
sets.description: Reads and exports the audit log, reads the user directory and reads any project; changes nothing.
